title: Pointer-centered image zoom
responsibility: Converts pinch gestures into bounded zoom requests and helps keep an image point under the pointer.

inputs.name: imageAnchor.image
inputs.description: Image whose rendered rectangle supplies coordinates.

inputs.name: keepPointerInPlace.image
inputs.description: Image after its size has changed.

inputs.name: keepPointerInPlace.pointer
inputs.description: Pointer location that should remain over that image point.

inputs.name: trackpadZoom.node
inputs.description: Element receiving wheel and gesture listeners.

inputs.name: trackpadZoom.controls
inputs.description: Function returning current/minimum/maximum zoom and an apply callback, or null when zoom is unavailable.

outputs.name: imageAnchor
outputs.description: Normalized image coordinates clamped to zero through one.

outputs.name: keepPointerInPlace
outputs.description: Adjusts horizontal and vertical scroll offsets to keep the specified image point under the pointer; returns no value.

outputs.name: trackpadZoom
outputs.description: Installs nonpassive Ctrl-wheel and Safari gesture listeners and returns destroy for cleanup. Zoom is clamped to supplied bounds, with null passed for fitted size. Ordinary wheel scrolling is untouched; active Safari gestures suppress duplicate Ctrl-wheel zoom.
